title: Shout
prompt: Return the text in capital letters with an exclamation mark on the end. "hi" becomes "HI!".
hints: There is a method for uppercase.

docs.name: text.to_upper() / text.to_lower()
docs.what: Returns the text in capitals, or in small letters.

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings into one. Numbers must be turned into text first.
